$comment: Licence policy for scripts/check-licences.mjs (backlog M0-T10). Changing this file needs review; a licence that is not permissive needs the owner (CLAUDE.md, 'Stop and ask the human'). Python-2.0 and CC-BY-4.0 are left out on purpose: no package uses them; add one only with a justification when a package needs it.

devOnly.reason: Weak, file-level copyleft. Accepted only for development dependencies that are not modified and never ship in the app or a Lambda bundle.
